phone.changelog: v3.17.53 / v3.9.50: unified left navigation rail on all three variants — fixed remote-first left rail that expands on focus, six permanent destinations (Home, Live TV, Movies, Series, Search, Settings). MovieBox, Anime and Torrents removed from visible nav everywhere; all three survive as content sources inside Movies/Series/Home so playback coverage is unchanged. Phone repair: the phone tree was a half-finished TV-shell port that lost its mobile shell — restored the full TV base (38 files ported) plus the phone-only delta, so one codebase ships across TV, Fire TV and Phone.
